scope: Recorded cases and access conditions, not automatic repair authorization or a diagnosis for an unmeasured unit.

routing.caveat: A splash hang plus working recovery is an access-condition match, not proof of identical damage or compatible firmware.
Do not infer the original NAND damage or reuse physical addresses from recovery unavailability alone.
Collect the access condition and symptoms first; do not silently choose a case.

cases.recovery_history: SD recovery was reached earlier; factory reset did not fix the unit. It was no longer reached during the successful deeper repair.
cases.method: Case-specific MaskROM, IDB/FlashInfo/BBT diagnosis, diagnostic boot, cache/system/userdata repairs and stock-boot return.
prerequisites: Verified private acquisitions and fresh mappings before device-specific writes
Matching official firmware and reviewed per-stage guards
cases.outcome: Cold normal startup, adapter/controller and GBC game confirmed by operator; binary stock-boot readback preceded final power removal.

cases.platform: Second early RF-1, bought in 2016; hardware observations attributed to owner
symptoms: factory reset and cache wipe did not restore startup
cases.method: Extract matching official system 0.2.0 update to plain Rockchip rkimage; install through working SD Recovery System v1.1.
prerequisites: Working Update rkimage from external storage menu
Matching firmware/hardware; extracted manifest reported SUPPORTED_PCBA=0x6,0x2
Preserve accessible data and review the firmware update write scope
cases.outcome: Owner reports recovery update/verification completion and normal startup.
